episodeTitle.en: How to break out of autopilot and create the life you want | Graham Weaver (Stanford GSB professor)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何摆脱自动驾驶模式，创造理想生活 | 格雷厄姆·威弗（斯坦福商学院教授）

guestBioOfficial.en: Graham Weaver teaches a top-rated course at Stanford’s Graduate School of Business (GSB), where he often unexpectedly ends up helping students figure out what to do with their lives. He is also the founder and CEO of Alpine Investors, a people-driven private equity firm. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why everything worthwhile requires suffering
guestBioOfficial.zh: 格雷厄姆·威弗在斯坦福商学院（GSB）教授一门备受欢迎的课程，他经常在课堂上帮助学生找到人生的方向。他同时也是Alpine Investors的创始人兼CEO，这是一家以人为本的私募股权公司。在本次对话中，我们探讨了：•为何一切有价值的事物都需要经历磨难

title.en: How to break out of autopilot and create the life you want | Graham Weaver (Stanford GSB professor)
title.zh: 如何摆脱自动驾驶模式，创造理想生活 | 格雷厄姆·威弗（斯坦福商学院教授）

summary.en: Graham shares practical frameworks for finding your path, including the 'genie' thought experiment (what would you wish for if any wholehearted pursuit were guaranteed to succeed?) and the 'nine lives' exercise. He argues that life is suffering, so you may as well choose something meaningful, and that everything you want lies on the other side of 'worse first'—the hard early days you must push through. The conversation also covers when to actually quit, and how to escape the autopilot mode most people live in. His advice comes from someone actively doing the work, not just teaching it.
summary.zh: Graham 分享了找到人生方向的实用框架，包括“神灯精灵”思维实验（如果任何全身心的追求都 guaranteed 成功，你会许什么愿？）和“九条命”练习。他主张人生本就充满苦难，所以不如选择有意义的事；你想要的一切都在“先苦后甜”的另一侧——你必须熬过那些艰难的开头。对话还涵盖了究竟何时该放弃，以及如何摆脱大多数人都在过的“自动驾驶”模式。他的建议来自一个真正在做事、而非只教书的人。
